---
title: "Interactive Regression Labs"
description: "Accessible, interactive help for the mathematical ideas in 161.251 Regression Modelling."
---

These labs are companions to the [lecture notes](../notes/). Each lab begins with a clean mathematical example and then offers presets using the datasets from the course.

Use the lecture number, concept, or search box to find a relevant activity. Every visual result is paired with exact values, an explanation, and a table so that the interaction does not depend on colour or sight alone.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
import {mountHub} from "./js/labs.js";
mountHub();
```

## How to use a lab

1. Start with the default synthetic example.
2. Change one control at a time and read the short interpretation below the figure.
3. Choose a course-data preset when you want to connect the idea to a lecture example.
4. Use **Reset** to return to the teaching state.

The calculations run in your browser. No answers or personal information are sent anywhere.
